label: Doffin
terms_note: Norwegian public procurement; open notices; bids on the buyer's KGV system.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (Doffin notices API behind an Azure APIM developer portal). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence low (portal reachable, docs not read).
auth: 1. Sign up on the portal → subscription key.
reference.limits: - Public procurement open data; bids via buyer KGV. - Norwegian public procurement; open notices; bids on the buyer's KGV system.

fields.name: subscription_key
fields.help: Subscription key for the 'Public API' product from the Doffin API developer portal (https://dof-notices-prod-api.developer.azure-api.net/, sign up → Products → subscribe), sent as the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header.

adapter.rate_note: The developer portal publishes no rate limit for the Public API product; Azure APIM answers 429 when a product quota applies. Two requests per second.
adapter.terms: Norwegian public procurement notices (DFØ); tenders are submitted on the buyer's own tendering system (KGV) linked from the notice.

search_postings.note: GET https://api.doffin.no/public/v2/search (Public API 'search': numHitsPerPage ≤ 100, page, searchString, cpvCode, status, type, location, issueDateFrom/To, estimatedValueFrom/To, sortBy). `query` → searchString; `category` → one cpvCode; `min_budget` → estimatedValueFrom (an integer amount, NOK); status is fixed to ACTIVE (open notices). Response PagedPublicNoticeDto {numHitsTotal, hits[]}: title = heading, buyer = buyer[0].name, budget_max = estimatedValue.amount (the estimate, a single value) in estimatedValue.currencyCode, skills = cpvCodes, deadline as published (null on some notice types). The notice page is https://www.doffin.no/notices/<id>; notice type, lots and locations stay in raw.

not_offered.me: The Public API has only search and download; there is no account or subscription endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The only per-notice call, GET /v2/download/{doffinId} ('Download notice'), returns the notice document itself; the portal publishes no response schema for it (only for search), so it cannot be mapped to fields. Use search_postings with the Doffin id in `query`, or open https://www.doffin.no/notices/<id>.
not_offered.submit_bid: Doffin is a notice board; tenders are delivered on the buyer's tendering system, and the Notices API (eform-api) only publishes notices for buyers.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging in the Public API (search and download only).
not_offered.send_message: No messaging in the Public API (search and download only).
